description: Save the entire plan once and immediately hand the returned dashboard URL to the user. Do NOT poll or wait for completion. Server handles dependencies, GPU waits, studio/email locks and quota retries. Default start=false lets the user review and start on the dashboard. start=true requires user authorization for automatic execution and every acknowledgement. A submitted plan continues after the chat closes or session expires. Send the same dopamine_hooks you validated; they are recorded in goal for the user to review.

acknowledge_execution.description: Confirm the user explicitly approved starting the production plan automatically.
acknowledge_execution.title: Acknowledge Execution

dopamine_hooks.description: Creative baseline: the dopamine hook(s) you built into the FINAL work. Declare at least one for any plan that creates image, voice, music, video or movie output, after reading dopamine_hooks_get. The server records each as a "[도파민 요소] …" line in goal, shown to the user on the dashboard.

channel.description: How the audience meets it: visual (시각), audio (음향) or situation (상황).

where.description: Where and how it appears in the finished work, in one line. Example: "0~3초: 오븐 문이 열리며 김이 오르는 빵 클로즈업".

goal.description: Desired finished deliverable and user-provided requirements.
goal.title: Goal

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for the intended operation. Reuse it on network retries.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

start.description: Start after submission when authorized; false saves a draft for review.
start.title: Start

steps.description: Production steps in dependency order, with studio arguments and result bindings.
steps.title: Steps

title.description: Display title for the plan or movie.
title.title: Title

title: Submit production plan
